overview: The Medford City Council heard presentations on Rare Disease Day and a student-led petition to ban polystyrene, ordered a wage theft audit for a police station contractor, and discussed residential zoning enforcement.

items.title: Rare Disease Day Announcement
items.summary: The Council heard a public service presentation from the Mattarese family regarding Rare Disease Awareness Day and galactosemia.

items.title: Petition 20-078 (Polystyrene Foam Ban)
items.summary: Referred to a Committee of the Whole a student petition and draft ordinance to ban polystyrene foam in Medford food establishments and city facilities.

items.title: Announcements on Airplane Noise and Medford High Foyer Painting
items.summary: Councilor Marks shared contact procedures for reporting Massport airplane noise complaints and recognized community volunteers who repainted the Medford High School foyer.

items.title: Resolution 20-076 (CB Scoops 10th Anniversary)
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating CB Scoops and the Roach family on their 10th anniversary and thanking them for their community service.

items.title: Resolution 20-077 (Police Headquarters Subcontractor Audit)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a compliance audit under the city's wage theft and responsible employer ordinances for a subcontractor working on the police station construction project.

items.title: Petition 20-069 (Zoning Loopholes and Construction Mitigation)
items.summary: Received and placed on file a presentation by resident Cheryl Rodriguez regarding lot coverage limits, stop-work enforcement, and dust mitigation during residential redevelopments.

items.title: Cancellation of March 3 Meeting
items.summary: Approved a motion to cancel the March 3, 2020 City Council meeting due to the primary election.

items.title: Public Participation (Neighborhood Trespassing Concern)
items.summary: Heard concerns from resident Carolyn Jones regarding adults filming and trespassing on private property, referring the matter to the police department.

items.title: Committee Reports and Approval of Records
items.summary: Tabled committee report 20-063 and approved the meeting records of February 18, 2020.
